correctness.rationale: A unique decomposition at all global minimum visits gives GF \(A(z)^2 E(z)^{r-1}\); exact factorization yields R=2 probability 1/4 and R=1 coefficient 1/2+u/2. The simultaneous unique minimum and unique adjacent-level event is possible only at an endpoint and has exact probability c_n by the ballot/reflection formula. The four cells exhaust n>=2, with parity inequalities c_even=u_(k-1)/2>u_k/2 and c_odd=u_k/2 making c_n the exact TV distance. 2^n path enumeration n=2..14 checked exactly, not substituted for proof; the theorem makes no claims outside symmetric lattice walks.

value.rationale: A natural finite-dimensional quantitative question left open by the qualitative first-K total-variation convergence framework: first nontrivial joint pair of minima, full exact finite-n law, sharp c_n rate and constant. The two-level endpoint event supplies an exact obstruction to limiting support and explains the TV profile. This is a structural sharp refinement, not a routine numerical extension or purported solution to the continuous-increment rate question.
